input:
Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候有一个人叫神农。他需要当上医，一看别的人就想帮助他们。但是，他有一个问题，他不知道什么东西能做药。神农听说一个远远的地方有一种植物，什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好。神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方，他看到一个很漂亮的植物，又香又好看。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 他需要当上医：医生
- 一看别的人就想帮助他们：看到，看look vs.看到see; 病人，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”
- 什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好：吃了以后
- 神农三个月走去：走了三个月

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，use this time expression for a historical setting; the listed form is not natural here.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 当上医：当上医生，the noun for a person who practises medicine is “医生”; “医” alone does not work as this job title.
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别的人：别人，“别的人” distinguishes people from another stated group, while “别人” means other people generally.
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一个远远的地方：一个很远的地方，“远远地” is normally an adverb describing an action; “很远的” naturally modifies “地方”.
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 什么病人：病人，“什么” is interrogative and cannot introduce a general group of patients in this statement.
6. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方：神农走了三个月，找到了有这种植物的地方，put the duration after the verb, use “了” for the completed journey and discovery, and use “这种植物” to mean the particular plant mentioned before.
7. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一个很漂亮的植物：一株很漂亮的植物，plants use a classifier such as “株” rather than the general classifier “个”.
8. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 病人吃都会觉得：病人吃了都会觉得，“吃了” marks the completed action that leads to the resulting feeling of improved health.

items.reason: 古代 already expresses a time period, so 古代的时候 is redundantly formed under the teacher's rule.
医 alone is not the appropriate noun for the profession here; 医生 is correct.
The intended people to help are 病人, so changing 别的人 to 别人 leaves the wrong referent in place.
远远的 can modify 地方 and is acceptable here, even though 很远的 is also natural.
什么病人吃都会觉得 can mean that any patient who eats it will feel better, and the teacher did not mark 什么病人.
走了三个月 correctly places the duration after the verb and marks the completed journey; the revised discovery clause is also correct.
个 is not the appropriate measure word for a plant here; 株 is correct.
吃了 correctly marks eating as completed before the resulting feeling of being better.
